tools.description: Search Cairn memory for past decisions, rules, gotchas and procedures. Returns cards {id,kind,title,summary,score}; more:n counts cut results; status:stale marks a doubted memory. kind=handoff returns the last session handoff. Fetch full records with memory_get.
tools.name: memory_search

tools.description: Full records (fields, evidence, links) for ids from memory_search.
tools.name: memory_get

tools.description: Save verified, reusable knowledge. reason: why it is true or was chosen (required except note). fields by kind: decision {context, alternatives[], consequences}; rule {exceptions}; gotcha {symptom, cause, fix}; procedure {steps[], when}; fact {source}; preference {example}. Correct a memory by saving the new version with supersedes=<old id> (your own memory, or a project memory of the same project). contradicts=<id> when it conflicts with a memory you cannot replace. scope defaults: project in an initialized repo, personal otherwise and for preference/note. No secrets, logs or guesses. items: up to 3 notes in one call.
tools.name: memory_save

tools.description: Mark a memory helpful or wrong. Wrong from two people, or from its owner, makes it stale.
tools.name: memory_feedback

tools.description: Erase a memory you own. To replace outdated knowledge, save with supersedes instead.
tools.name: memory_forget
